seo.title: Hurricane Melissa Relief
seo.description: Your contribution immediately translates into targeted support for Haitian families, focusing on direct cash aid and agricultural recovery to build long-term stability.

images.alt: A flooded road below an eroded, collapsed hillside after the hurricane
A woman wading through floodwater between damaged homes

sections.heading: Make a difference
sections.body: Change starts with people like you. Your donation helps make a real impact, one action at a time. Together, we can do more.

tiers.description: Funds a sanitation/hygiene kit and a meal voucher for one affected family (6). This ensures their access to clean water at a selected Saradi vendor's cart and provides one subsidized nutritious meal.
Activates one Saradi as a temporary mobile cash/food voucher disbursement point, covering their setup for critical transfers, ensuring money and food reaches vulnerable families immediately
Provides comprehensive assistance for one struggling farmer. This includes basic farming tools, organic seeds, and a small mobile cash grant to cover urgent debris removal and clean-up labor.
Establishes a permanent clean water station at a Saradi's location, supplying enough water filters and purification tablets to serve their immediate area for weeks, anchoring community health efforts
Provides an advance purchase agreement to a recovering farmer. This guaranteed income allows them to repair irrigation/storage damage and ensures RADIKAL's future local supply chain is maintained.
